title: Bunk's band routines, personnel, Chicago, Lee Collins and Sidney Bechet
summary: Details of Bunk's cues, repeated numbers and drummers, the Orchestra Hall concert and 1947 tour, then playing with Lee Collins, ragtime, and Sidney Bechet at Jazz Limited.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
